  WHY: Path lists and marker lines can make the rendered targeted-file-context block exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]

  WHY: The unguarded call hits `command not found`, and guarded callers can silently skip authenticated pushes.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:removed _memory_git function (old lines 597-608) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
